name: CertificateOfConformanceViewer
tagline: CoC and EN 10204 test certificates by lot – results vs spec and customer limits, acknowledge, query, print and download.
description: An advanced PCF control for manufacturers' customer portals: find certificates of conformance, 3.1/3.2 inspection certificates and certificates of analysis by lot, heat or PO, see every result against the certificate specification and the customer's own limits, follow revisions, acknowledge receipt, raise queries and print or download – in Power Pages, Canvas apps and model-driven apps.
features: Search by lot, heat, certificate, part or PO
Type, result and issue-date filters with five sort orders
Certificate document by type (CoC, EN 10204 3.1/3.2, CoA)
Results vs spec with spec bars and individual values
Verdicts incl. near limit and accepted under deviation
Print, results CSV, certificate HTML and bulk download
Phone sheet, tablet and wide split layouts
State JSON, outputs and DOM event
